schema.text: How is the cycling space separated from walking or motor traffic?

options.text: Separate from people walking, at the same level
Different level or kerb from people walking

en.#How is the cycling space separated from: How is the cycling space separated from walking or motor traffic?
en.#Separate from people walking, at the sa: Separate from people walking, at the same level
en.#Different level or kerb from people wal: Different level or kerb from people walking

it.#How is the cycling space separated from: Come è separato lo spazio ciclabile dalle persone a piedi o dal traffico motorizzato?
it.#Separate from people walking, at the sa: Separato dalle persone a piedi, allo stesso livello
it.#Different level or kerb from people wal: Livello diverso o cordolo rispetto allo spazio pedonale

fr.#How is the cycling space separated from: Comment l’espace cyclable est-il séparé des piétons ou de la circulation motorisée ?
fr.#Paint or road markings only: Peinture ou marquages au sol uniquement
fr.#Separate from people walking, at the sa: Séparé des piétons, au même niveau
fr.#Different level or kerb from people wal: Niveau différent ou bordure par rapport aux piétons

de.#How is the cycling space separated from: Wie ist der Radbereich vom Fuß- oder Kraftfahrzeugverkehr getrennt?
de.#Separate from people walking, at the sa: Vom Fußverkehr getrennt, auf gleicher Höhe
de.#Different level or kerb from people wal: Andere Höhe oder Bordstein gegenüber dem Fußverkehr

tr.#How is the cycling space separated from: Bisiklet alanı yayalardan veya motorlu trafikten nasıl ayrılmış?
tr.#Different level or kerb from people wal: Yürüyen kişilerden farklı seviyede veya bordürle ayrılmış

fa.#How is the cycling space separated from: فضای دوچرخه چگونه از عابران پیاده یا ترافیک موتوری جدا شده است؟
fa.#Separate from people walking, at the sa: جدا از عابران پیاده و هم‌سطح با آنان
fa.#Different level or kerb from people wal: سطح متفاوت یا جدول جداکننده از عابران پیاده

hu.#How is the cycling space separated from: Hogyan választják el a kerékpáros teret a gyalogos vagy gépjárműforgalomtól?
hu.#Different level or kerb from people wal: A gyalogosoktól eltérő szinten vagy szegéllyel elválasztva

ar.#How is the cycling space separated from: كيف تفصل مساحة الدراجات عن المشاة أو حركة المركبات؟
ar.#Bollards, barriers, kerbs, or planters: أعمدة أو حواجز أو حواف أو أحواض نباتات
ar.#Separate from people walking, at the sa: منفصلة عن المشاة وعلى المستوى نفسه
ar.#Different level or kerb from people wal: مستوى مختلف أو حافة فاصلة عن المشاة
